title: Documentation and Prior Authorization Unit Standard: Order Quantity per 30 Days on Model Change Grants, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
**Standard.** For the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, when Larkfield records the authorization grant for a new written order of the CGM supply allowance (A4239) that changes the CGM model under the payer authorization already in force, the quantity-reading adjustment replaces the units per 30 days written on the order (the newest written order of the item) by the following rules:

1. when the order's quantity per 30 days is above the tier's sensor allowance units per 30 days of supply **and** equals that allowance multiplied by the 30-day blocks of one standard shipment, it is read as a per-shipment count and divided by those blocks, giving the billing units per block;
2. when it is any other quantity above the tier's allowance, the order supports only the tier's allowance;
3. otherwise, that is, when the quantity is not above the allowance, the quantity as written applies.

The 30-day blocks of one standard shipment are the tier's standard days of supply per refill shipment divided by 30. The figure these rules give takes the place of the units per 30 days written on the order.

### Figures the standard turns on, every tier

| Tier | Sensor allowance units per 30 days | Standard days of supply per refill shipment | 30-day blocks of one standard shipment | Quantity read as a per-shipment count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 1 | 30 | 1 | none (allowance times 1 is not above 1) |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 1 | 30 | 1 | none |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 1 | 90 | 3 | 3, read as 1 per block |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 1 | 90 | 3 | 3, read as 1 per block |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 1 | 90 | 3 | 3, read as 1 per block |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 1 | 30 | 1 | none |

### Reading table by quantity written

| Quantity per 30 days written on the order | Tier with 90 days per shipment | Tier with 30 days per shipment |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 (as written) | 0 (as written) |
| 1 | 1 (as written; not above the allowance of 1) | 1 (as written) |
| 2 | 1 (above 1, not equal to 3: the allowance) | 1 (above 1: the allowance) |
| 3 | 1 (equals 1 multiplied by 3 blocks: 3 divided by 3) | 1 (above 1: the allowance) |
| 4 or more | 1 (the allowance) | 1 (the allowance) |

### Points of judgement

- *Where does the threshold sit?* At the tier's allowance of 1 billing unit per 30 days on every tier: a quantity of 1 is not above it and the quantity as written applies; a quantity of 2 is above it.
- *When is a quantity a per-shipment count?* Only when it is above the allowance and is exactly the allowance multiplied by the blocks of one standard shipment; on a tier whose standard shipment is 90 days that quantity is 3, and on a tier whose standard shipment is 30 days no quantity above the allowance meets it.
- *Which order is read?* The newest written order of the CGM supply allowance on the program, by order date, the one whose model change the grant records.
